canonical.behaviour: Release everything on main as 2.9.0-rc.3 and install it. The version changes from 2.9.0-rc.2 to 2.9.0-rc.3 wherever the package states it (the rules stay 1.9.0). CHANGELOG.md gets a plain-English rc.3 entry: /spar, the worktree guard, the approval fixes, the blast-radius and Unslop work, one writing rule set and plain owner questions, with the known gaps listed (/spar not yet tried live with a kept SPAR.md turned into a plan, a cancel, one-model mode, or a cross-model run since its start card changed; the worktree-guard and delegated-prompt follow-ups). UPGRADE.md gets an rc.2 to rc.3 section. VALIDATION.md is rewritten from a fresh full run. Then one commit and a push to main, `claude plugin update workflow-axa@gazohhh`, and the Codex copies in ~/.agents/skills replaced from the release ZIP after a full backup, with /spar added as the 20th folder, checked by `audit_installation.py --check-global`. Each released task's checkpoint says it shipped in rc.3.
operations: replace the 19 workflow-axa folders in C:/Users/Cem/.agents/skills and add spar, after a backup
exclusions: no change to how any skill or hook works; release records only
no change to the user's global CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or ARTIFACTS.md (global_policy.py and activate_rules.py --apply are not run)
no force push and no rewrite of published history
skills in ~/.agents/skills that are not workflow-axa's stay untouched
conditions: every installed folder equals the release build afterwards (diff, __pycache__ ignored)
the Codex backup is made and checked before any installed folder is replaced
the full suite and validate pass before the commit
checks: audit_installation.py --check-global reports DISK_MATCH with no missing folder
full suite: python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
